purpose: Actual REAPER MIDI delivery, dry identity, persistent settings, and explicit Panic with the already built uninstalled Neural Lab package

reaper.license: Official fully functional evaluation; no copied license or license bypass

protocol.environment: GitHub CPU, Xvfb, isolated REAPER profile, explicit JACK dummy server96000/512 with5333us pacing, no user profile or hardware
protocol.configuration: Existing packaged model/decoder and default-OFF gate; no processing or policy changes
protocol.recording: Full111.35 seconds plus0.5 seconds tail; if no held output at EOF, seek10 seconds and allow at most12 seconds to establish a held note for explicit Panic
protocol.state: Verify gate OFF and threshold-60 default; save gate ON/threshold-54, mutate and restore; reset OFF/-60 before playback
protocol.panic: After full playback, silence future input upstream, explicitly request Panic while held MIDI exists, observe1 second; require all note owners released and no new attacks
protocol.gates: Actual96000/512, full source without discontinuity, real-time wall pacing, dry error0, no capture overflow, MIDI received, raw pairing valid, state restoration, nonvacuous Panic
protocol.limits: No audio-device, live guitar, musical quality, string assignment, MPE, callback deadline/allocation or installation claim. Observation overhead excluded from native timing evidence.
protocol.failure: Record actual failure; no automatic retry, tuning or policy change
protocol.artifacts: Small report/logs collected once; generated MIDI retained remote; no audio re-upload
protocol.audio_start: Start named JACK dummy server, retain ports and INI, call Audio_Init, require Audio_IsRunning and JACK mode before playback; fail within3s if callbacks/transport do not advance.
